remake.swap: 1) replace the woman's head with the head of the Shiba Inu from image 1; 2) change her red tracksuit completely into a khaki-green aviator flight jumpsuit with a small leather collar patch (no red tracksuit anywhere); 3) turn her visible arms and hands holding and pouring the container into thick furry Shiba front legs with round paws; 4) turn her visible legs and feet into thick furry Shiba hind legs with round paws; 5) the helicopter cabin and the volcano landscape may be lightly restyled while keeping the same mood and action
remake.ending: In the same popcorn-filled helicopter cabin, the Shiba Inu in a khaki-green aviator flight jumpsuit with a small leather collar patch sits in front of a bowl of freshly fried, steaming-hot golden ring-shaped meat popcorn treats that look exactly like the rings in image 2; it bites one ring, flinches because it is hot, opens its mouth and huffs out hot air with its tongue out while steam rises, then chews happily with eyes half closed. The product bag from image 2 stands clearly visible next to the bowl.
